$comment: Descriptor field register — the ONE place a field on the per-file record is declared. The record is created by the crawler, cloned-and-extended by every chain processor (Copy-Bag), and reduced to an entry by assemble. This file is READ BY CODE: rs.core.assemble derives its bag exclusions (scope=ingestion) and core set (scope=core) from it; tests/crawler.tests.ps1 asserts the crawler stamps exactly the origin=crawler fields. Anything a processor attaches that is NOT listed here is an element by default (open element model) — the register declares dispositions, it does not close the bag. To add a field: stamp it in its origin stage AND add a line here; forgetting the line makes it ride into the payload as an element, which the golden test catches.

scopes.core: always on a code-track entry; excluded from Header.Elements counting because presence is guaranteed
scopes.ingestion: ingestion-side fact; stripped from entry bags by assemble; never a row column, never in Header.Elements
scopes.element: rides into the entry bag and is counted in Header.Elements; the writer decides emission

AbsolutePath.note: read target only; never in a payload (path doctrine)

RelativePath.note: root-anchored, forward slashes, no leading slash; the payload path column

NodePath.note: directory portion of RelativePath, trailing '/', root = ''; graph key

Extension.note: [Path]::GetExtension — leading '.', '' if none; ignore blacklist + routing read it

CreationUtc.note: Kind=Utc; free from the same stat; un-exclude if a writer wants it

FsAttributes.note: System.IO.FileAttributes flags; not 'Attributes' — that name is the rs-attributes element

Content.note: decoded text; mutators replace it via Copy-Bag; may be absent when ReadError is set

Encoding.note: currently an asserted decode policy ('UTF-8'), not a measurement — decisions-ledger #28 / encoding-lookback-brief

ReadError.note: set with _ChainHalt on read failure; under LeanPayload the item routes to Diagnostics before bag construction, under KeepContentless it is retained

_ChainHalt.note: chain mechanics; set by any processor that halts the chain
